voice.suffix: Short, no words, no music, dry, close-up.

hello.emotion: a warm low burbling babble in the rhythm of a friendly 'heh-lloo!', mumbled creature chatter that almost sounds like saying hello, rising slightly at the end

poke1.emotion: a curious questioning 'huh?' sound with a small rising inflection

poke2.emotion: a happy delighted low chuff and soft burbling giggle, rounded and mellow

poke3.emotion: a warm affectionate coo, soft and melting, content

poke4.emotion: a playful giggly babble, bouncy and teasing

poke5.emotion: a mildly bothered grumble, a small 'hmph', slightly annoyed

poke6.emotion: a fed-up low grumbling groan, a protesting rumbly moan, deep and grumpy, increasingly annoyed

poke7.emotion: an indignant cheeky outburst, a deep huffy grunting protest ending in a defiant raspberry

pickup.emotion: a surprised yelp as if suddenly lifted into the air, 'whoa!'

drop.emotion: a soft landing thump with a low animal grunt and a relieved purring sigh, a chubby furry creature, not a human voice

emote1.emotion: a triumphant excited cheer made of deep bouncy chuffs and a happy rumbling burble, low and round, not high-pitched

emote2.emotion: a swooning lovestruck sigh with a dreamy coo

emote3.emotion: a sheepish apologetic 'oops' whimper, embarrassed, trailing off

emote4.emotion: a goofy silly babble with a wobbling trill

emote5.emotion: a sassy smug 'mm-hm', sarcastic and unimpressed

emote6.emotion: a smug teasing taunt in animal sounds only, a playful mocking lilt of cheeky creature noises, not a human voice, no words

foil.voice: A chubby sleepy pack rat with a soft warm plush-toy cartoon voice: low-to-mid pitched chuffs, burbling chatter and rounded little grunts, like a purring hamster, mellow and breathy, never shrill, no squeaks, no squeals

poke: Bet I can dodge the next one!
I'm charging a booster fee now.
Poke me again and I keep your deck.
lines.drop: Landed it! Ten out of ten.

cinder.voice: A chubby baby dragon with a soft warm plush-toy cartoon voice: gentle low-to-mid pitched burbling coos, rumbly purring growls and small snorting puffs with tiny fire sputters, rounded and mellow, never shrill, no chirps, no screeches

poke: Okay, I like you. A lot.

folio.voice: A friendly living storybook creature with a soft warm plush-toy cartoon voice: soft papery page flutters, warm low burbling babbles, gentle growly gasps and rounded little snaps, mellow, never shrill, no chirps

poke: Quiz time: what is a stack?
One more poke and I bite.

gloop.voice: A cute squishy blob of mana slime with a plush-toy cartoon voice: soft round bubbly blorps, gurgles and happy wet squeaks, warm and mellow, never shrill

emote: Even I'd win. I'm a puddle.

sprout.voice: A shy little mandrake sapling with a soft plush-toy cartoon voice: gentle low-to-mid pitched coos, tiny rustling whimpers and soft rounded peeps, mellow, never shrill, no screams

lines.pickup: Not the roots! Not the roots!

wick.voice: A cozy candle wisp with a soft plush-toy cartoon voice: gentle low breathy hums, warm flickering whistles and soft rounded sighs, mellow, never shrill

crit.voice: A chunky friendly stone golem with a plush-toy cartoon voice: warm low rumbly grunts, soft clacking rolls and goofy rounded hums, mellow, never shrill

poke: Dare me to roll? I dare me.

nimbus.voice: A gentle baby whale calf with a soft plush-toy cartoon voice: warm low airy coos, dreamy hummed sighs and soft rounded squeaks, mellow, never shrill

poke: Stay close. I'll hum for you.
Even whales get grumpy, you know.
I'll rain on you. Just a little.

hex.voice: A chubby sleepy house cat with a soft warm plush-toy cartoon voice: gentle low-to-mid pitched mews and a rumbling purr, rounded and mellow, never shrill, no squeals

poke: Poke me once more. I dare you.
emote: It wasn't me. I was napping.

ribbit.voice: A chunky little frog knight with a plush-toy cartoon voice: warm low croaks, soft ribbits and bubbly throat chirps, mellow and rounded, never shrill

poke: Unhand me, or I shall... hide.
emote: I knighted a fly. It left.
